checks.detail: Default scene.py produces a solid black video which scores 0.0 due to SSIM gating at 0.70 against a non-trivial reference animation.
Clean-room restore from pristine tarball, source-level anti-cheat grep, user separation, strace containment, and /logs/verifier lockdown collectively block all validated attack vectors.
Agent runs as non-root user via `su agent -c` in test.sh line 51 with `user = "agent"` in task.toml.
Agent code execution is wrapped in `strace -f` with `timeout 300` (test.sh lines 48-51), blocking until all forked children exit.
Scoring script runs from /tests/ using /tests/.venv/bin/python, never imports from /app, and only reads the copied agent video and verified source snapshot.
All crash paths use fail_with() which writes reward 0.0 and exits 0; strace and scorer commands have explicit timeouts (300s and 600s respectively).

measures: /tests chmod 700 root-only; /logs/verifier chmod 700 + rm -rf at verification start
Agent runs as non-root 'agent' user; cannot modify system binaries, /etc, /tests, or /logs/verifier
Full /app wipe via find -delete, restore from /tests/pristine_app.tar, only verified scene.py carried forward
Comprehensive grep blocks file I/O, subprocess, eval/exec, encoding, and video reading APIs in scene.py
strace -f with timeout 300 wraps agent code execution, preventing background process persistence
/home/agent, /tmp, /dev/shm, /var/tmp, /solution all wiped before agent code execution; pkill -9 -u agent kills stale processes
